integrity: Exact exhaustive finite proof; code certifies all normalized pairs at two primes with a Hadamard lifting bound, and a separate rational rank checker validates each symmetry representative. All inputs and counts are contained in the package.
scientific_limitations: Fixed signed coefficient pattern (+1,+1,-1) only on three distinct elements of A5; no general coefficient parameterization, no nonzero singular-value estimates, and independent verification has not been performed. An unindexed equivalent signed group-ring classification may exist.
title: Signed three-tap convolution has seven exact rank strata on the icosahedral rotation group
